title: En frierhistorie
world: Old rural Norway, long ago, in late winter. The poor little farm is a single tiny, lopsided cottage of grey, weathered logs with a sagging, snow-covered turf roof, a crooked chimney, one small window and a low door. Inside is one cramped room with a bare plank floor, a rough little table, a wobbly bench along the wall, two rickety stools and a three-legged stool, a small stone fireplace in the corner with a sooty kettle, and one shelf with two cracked clay bowls. Almost everything is old, grey and patched. The only new things in the house are the farmer's one new sleeve, the wife's one new shoe and the daughter's new cap. The suitor carries a small, square brown leather travel bag with a brass clasp.
palette: Late winter on a frosty February afternoon: old, crusted snow with lilac-blue shadows, long icicles on the eaves and a low, pink sun. Inside the cottage: warm orange firelight and smoky brown shadows, from which the family's three new things shine out: a bright lingonberry-red sleeve, a glossy black shoe with a silver buckle and an emerald-green cap.

cast.name: Frieren
cast.description: En godhjertet gutt som reiser rundt for å finne noen å bli glad i, og som møter folk med et åpent sinn.
cast.look: A tall, gangly young man of about eighteen with a round, eager face, apple-pink cheeks, a small blunt nose, bright hopeful blue eyes, a nervous smile and neat butter-blond hair parted in the middle and slicked down flat, with one stubborn tuft sticking up at the back. He wears his best clothes: a slightly too short cinnamon-brown jacket with brass buttons, a white shirt with a little black bow tie, grey striped trousers, polished black boots and a squashed tall black hat, and carries a small brown leather travel bag.

cast.name: Bonden
cast.description: Gårdsmannen som er stolt av det ene nye ermet sitt og prøver å virke som en ekstra flink husbonde når han får besøk.
cast.look: A big, burly, barrel-chested farmer of about fifty with a broad, ruddy face, a small snub nose, twinkling little blue eyes, bushy brown eyebrows, a shock of unruly brown hair and a long brown beard that splits into two scraggly forks. He wears a faded, patched grey-brown wool jacket whose right sleeve is brand-new, bright lingonberry-red and spotless, while the old left sleeve has a big hole at the elbow, patched brown trousers and worn-out boots.
cast.portrait: Background: the cramped cottage room with the little table.

cast.name: Kona på gården
cast.description: Hun har fått én ny sko og later som hun rydder opp overalt ved å dytte møbler litt til side på en viktig måte.
cast.look: A small, wiry, bustling woman of about forty-five with a narrow, freckled face, a long pointed nose, bright little grey eyes, a busy, pursed mouth and frizzy ginger hair escaping from a patched brown headscarf. She wears a patched mud-brown skirt, a faded grey-blue blouse and a ragged grey shawl. On her right foot is one brand-new, glossy black leather shoe with a big silver buckle; on her left foot, an old, holey grey felt slipper.
cast.portrait: Background: the cramped cottage room with the rickety stools.

cast.name: Datteren
cast.description: Datteren som passer godt på den nye lua si og derfor bare titter inn og nikker rundt, som om hun ordner alt på én gang.
cast.look: A cheeky girl of about seventeen with a long face, a pointed chin, a turned-up nose, big round brown eyes, pink cheeks, a little rosebud mouth and thick black hair in two short, stiff plaits that stick straight out sideways. She wears a patched, faded brown pinafore dress over a grey blouse, and on her head a brand-new, bright emerald-green knitted cap with a big fluffy white pom-pom, which she is very proud of.

cover.prompt: In deep snow on a frosty winter afternoon, the Suitor, in his best clothes and squashed tall hat, with his little travel bag in one hand, knocks politely on the low door of a tiny, lopsided cottage with a sagging, snow-covered turf roof and icicles on the eaves. From the one small window beside the door, three curious faces peek out at him, squashed together: the Farmer, the Farmer's Wife and the Daughter in her new green cap. A low pink sun and lilac-blue shadows.
cover.caption: En frier banker på døra til en liten, fattig gård.
cover.alt: En ung frier med høy hatt og liten reiseveske banker på døra til ei lita, skjev stue i snøen. I vinduet ved siden av titter tre nysgjerrige ansikter ut.

illustrations.anchor: Og så gned han bordet med det nye ermet.
illustrations.prompt: Inside the cramped, firelit cottage room, the Suitor sits politely on the wobbly bench with his tall hat and little travel bag on his knees. In front of him, the Farmer proudly polishes the rough little table with his one bright red new sleeve in big sweeping strokes, while he hides his other arm, with its holey old sleeve, behind his back. The Suitor watches with raised eyebrows and a polite smile. A sooty kettle hangs over the small fire.
illustrations.caption: Gni, gni, gni! Bonden gnir bordet med det nye ermet.
illustrations.alt: Bonden gnir bordet med det nye, røde ermet sitt og gjemmer det gamle ermet med hull bak ryggen. Frieren sitter høflig på benken med reisevesken på fanget.

illustrations.anchor: Datteren hadde fått ei ny lue.
illustrations.prompt: In the cramped, firelit cottage room, the Farmer's Wife sticks out her foot in its one shiny new black shoe with the silver buckle and shoves a rickety stool across the floor, her other foot in an old holey slipper. In the low doorway, only the Daughter's head pokes in, wearing her brand-new green knitted cap, nodding this way and that. The Farmer stands proudly with his red new sleeve held out in front. The Suitor sits on the bench with his little travel bag on his knees, trying hard not to laugh.
illustrations.caption: Datteren stikker bare hodet inn gjennom døra og nikker. Nikk, nikk, nikk.
illustrations.alt: Kona dytter en krakk med den nye skoen sin. I døråpningen stikker datteren inn hodet med den nye, grønne lua og nikker. Bonden viser fram det nye ermet, og frieren prøver å ikke le.
